rules.name: Generate videos only on explicit request
rules.description: Opening, uploading, refreshing, scrolling or hovering may create image previews but must never submit video generation. Video submission requires the user clicking Generate video. Reuse saved paid request tickets on retries.

rules.name: Truthful model routing
rules.description: Select only models supported by the implemented adapter and available credentials. Show actual provider, model, candidate exclusions and concise reason. Prelint reviews and records routing policy; never fabricate a live Prelint routing API or claim review approval without a successful check for the matching policy revision.

rules.name: Preserve originals and secrets
rules.description: New uploads and edits must preserve existing originals, conversations and versions. Never commit or return API keys, .env, original uploads, private request tickets or server credentials.
